doc: Combat rules. window_s: the one 'in combat' rule (scripts/match/in_combat.gd). A Hunter or a Boki is in combat for window_s seconds after it deals or takes damage in a fight: a hit on or from a Hunter, a Boki, a monster or Blight. Healing, falls, wall slams, heat, friendly fire and damage to yourself don't count. A Boki's fight is its owner's too. Hunter shield refill, a Boki's own mending, the drive music, a Boki's 10 Hz think out of combat and a Boki's refused orders all read it, so they switch on the same frame. (Far bots' 20 Hz step is SimLod's, not this window: far fights are slowed on purpose.) The target feel pauses health recovery 4 s after a hit and marks recent combat for 4 s, so 4 s is the one shared value (was 5 s). anti_heal_cut: how much of a heal Anti-Heal (blight) takes away when the source gives no amount of its own: 0.7 leaves 30% of every heal (the target feel is 0.3; was 0.6, 40% left). heal_given_k: every heal a Hunter gives ANOTHER Hunter is scaled by this (target feel: healing given -35%); a heal on yourself ignores it (scripts/match/heal_rules.gd). regen: every Hunter wins back pct_per_tick of max health each tick_s (0.1% per 0.1 s, about 1%/s), paused pause_s after it last took a hit (Hunter.hurt_at; heat and a Boki's care don't restart it), cut by Anti-Heal like any heal. anti_heal_on: the target feel's switch for Anti-Heal: on, a blighted target gets 1 - anti_heal_cut of a heal (0.3); off, it gets no healing at all. A Hunter outside the tide ring (Heart.tide_r) gets no healing of any kind, recovery included (the target feel's storm blocks healing). Channels (a recall, an exit call, a rune, a box revive) are not on this window: the source cancels them on the hit itself, so they read Hunter.hurt_at.
